messageValues.message:
You are an expert data parser for LinkedIn job postings. Extract structured information from Google search results of LinkedIn jobs.

Your task is to:
1. Parse each search result item
2. Extract ALL email addresses found
3. Identify job details
4. Return structured JSON data

Rules:
- Extract emails from both title and snippet
- Identify company names accurately
- Determine if job is remote
- Extract salary information if present
- Categorize email types (personal/company/recruiter)

Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact format:
{
  "jobs": [
    {
      "jobTitle": "string",
      "company": "string",
      "location": "string",
      "emails": ["email1@example.com"],
      "emailType": "personal|company|recruiter",
      "isRemote": boolean,
      "salary": "string or null",
      "link": "string",
      "snippet": "string (max 200 chars)",
      "hasEmail": boolean
    }
  ],
  "summary": {
    "totalResults": number,
    "resultsWithEmails": number,
    "emailBreakdown": {
      "personal": number,
      "company": number,
      "recruiter": number
    }
  },
  "pagination": {
    "hasMore": boolean,
    "nextStartIndex": number
  }
}
=Parse these LinkedIn job search results and extract all relevant information, especially email addresses:\n\n{{ JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) }}

values.content:
=Generate ONE new LinkedIn search query based on {{ $json.searchQuery }}. 

Rules:
- Do NOT change the "site:" portion of the query.
- Keep the pattern and structure consistent.
- Replace or append only the job title and optionally add a location or industry.
- Ensure the new query introduces a different job role from a different industry or sector (e.g., healthcare, education, finance, tech, manufacturing, hospitality, etc.).
- Only return ONE complete query as plain text (no explanations, no list).
